title: Flix Annotation Inventory Schema
description: Schema for ast/annotation.json, enumerating every annotation the pinned Flix reference defines. This is a third vocabulary, needed because the first two cannot express it: the lexer emits a single TokenKind.Annotation for all of them, so the name survives only in the token's text and no TokenKind digest moves when one is added, removed or renamed. It is a COVERAGE vocabulary and never a validity check -- the Annotation token is genuinely open, because Java interop annotations lex identically and upstream models them with Annotation.Error.

upstreamCommit.description: The pinned commit this inventory was reflected from.

annotationDigest.description: SHA-256 over the sorted names, newline-joined. Asserted against pin.json, so an annotation cannot enter or leave the vocabulary without a human editing the pin.

name.description: The annotation as the reference writes it, read from its toString rather than derived from the class name: TailRecursive renders as @Tailrec, so deriving would produce a name the reference never emits.
